case.request: Build a useful planter from the available boards, keeping cuts within stock and every joint executable.

design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking open planter for herbs or flowers on a patio, for one person. Interior is about 36 × 16 cm with 18 cm side height, giving at least 15 cm soil depth when filled below the rim. Board-c is left as spare stock.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for cutting.
Mark the 40 cm base length.
Saw board into 40 cm base and offcut.
Place the second board flat for cutting.
Mark 40, 40, 16 and 16 cm parts.
Saw out front, back, both ends and offcut.
Sand all cut parts smooth.
Place the base flat on the ground.
Drill three drainage holes through the base.
Stand the front on the base front edge.
Stand the back on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between front and back.
Fit the right end between front and back.
Drive screws through front into left end.
Drive screws through front into right end.
Drive screws through back into left end.
Drive screws through back into right end.
Drive screws through base into front.
Drive screws through base into back.
Drive screws through base into left end.
Drive screws through base into right end.
